title: Eventual matching of a finite local stage family
statement: Let $I$ be a nonempty directed preorder, $D:I^{op}\to\mathrm{Scheme}$ a diagram of quasi-compact quasi-separated schemes with affine transition maps, and $c$ a limiting cone with apex $X$ and projections $p_j$. Fix $i_0\in I$, a sheaf of sets $G$ on the small étale site of $D(i_0)$ [def-weil-pbc-etale-sheaves], and an affine étale object $W$ over $D(i_0)$ [def-weil-pbc-full-affine-etale-site]. Index the upper tail by objects $j$ of $\mathrm{Over}(op\,i_0)$, with structure map $f_j:D(j)\to D(i_0)$. Set $H_j=f_j^*G$, $L=p_{i_0}^*G$, $B_j$ equal to base change along $p_j$, $Y_j=f_j^*W$, and let $e_j:p_{i_0}^*W\cong B_jY_j$ be the canonical iterated-fibre-product isomorphism. Put $\beta_j=\beta(p_j,f_j,p_{i_0}):H_j\to(p_j)_*L$ [def-weil-pbc-sets-sheaf-comparison]. Fix $t\in L(p_{i_0}^*W)$. Suppose a stage $j$, a finite covering family $a_q:V_q\to Y_j$ with each $V_q$ affine, and sections $s_q\in H_j(V_q)$ are given with $\beta_j(s_q)=L(B_j(a_q)\circ e_j^{-1})(t)$. Then there is a later stage $j′$ and its arrow $r:j′\to j$. Write $b_r$ for base change along $D(r)$, $d_r:Y_{j′}\cong b_rY_j$ for the canonical iterated-base-change isomorphism, $V′_q=b_rV_q$, $a′_q=b_r(a_q)\circ d_r^{-1}$, and $s′_q=\beta(D(r),f_j,f_{j′})(s_q)$. The generated sieve of the $a′_q$ covers $Y_{j′}$, the equations $\beta_{j′}(s′_q)=L(B_{j′}(a′_q)\circ e_{j′}^{-1})(t)$ hold, and the family $s′$ is compatible: for all $Z$ and arrows $z:Z\to V′_q$, $z′:Z\to V′_{q′}$ with $z\circ a′_q=z′\circ a′_{q′}$, the two restricted sections $H_{j′}(z)(s′_q)$ and $H_{j′}(z′)(s′_{q′})$ agree. No global stage section is part of the conclusion.

proof.text: Apply the eventual compatibility lemma to the finite family and its common limit image, without using the covering hypothesis, to obtain j′, r and compatibility.

Apply Scheme.coverPreserving_overPullback to the original covering sieve. Rewrite its functor pushforward using Sieve.functorPushforward_ofArrows. Pull the sieve back along the canonical iterated-base-change isomorphism d.hom and rewrite with Sieve.pullback_ofArrows_of_iso to get exactly the displayed transported covering.
Apply preservation of local image equations along the chosen r. Pair the transported covering, preserved equations and eventual compatibility to obtain the original conclusion.

theorem etaleSet_eventualLocalStageMatching
    {I : Type u} [Preorder I] [IsDirected I (· ≤ ·)] [Nonempty I]
    (D : Iᵒᵖ ⥤ Scheme.{u})
    [∀ i : Iᵒᵖ, CompactSpace (D.obj i)]
    [∀ i : Iᵒᵖ, QuasiSeparatedSpace (D.obj i)]
    [∀ {i j : Iᵒᵖ} (a : i ⟶ j), IsAffineHom (D.map a)]
    (c : Cone D) (hc : IsLimit c) (i₀ : I)
    (G : Sheaf (D.obj (op i₀)).smallEtaleTopology (Type (u + 1)))
    (W : (D.obj (op i₀)).FullAffineEtale)
    (t : ((Scheme.etaleSetPullback (c.π.app (op i₀))).obj G).obj.obj
      (op ((MorphismProperty.Over.pullback @Etale ⊤ (c.π.app (op i₀))).obj W.obj))) :
    let H := fun j : Over (op i₀) ↦ (Scheme.etaleSetPullback (D.map j.hom)).obj G
    let L := (Scheme.etaleSetPullback (c.π.app (op i₀))).obj G
    let B := fun j : Over (op i₀) ↦ MorphismProperty.Over.pullback @Etale ⊤ (c.π.app j.left)
    let Y := fun j : Over (op i₀) ↦
      (MorphismProperty.Over.pullback @Etale ⊤ (D.map j.hom)).obj W.obj
    let e := fun j : Over (op i₀) ↦
      (MorphismProperty.Over.pullbackComp (P := @Etale) (Q := ⊤)
        (c.π.app j.left) (D.map j.hom) (c.π.app (op i₀)) (c.w j.hom).symm).app W.obj
    let β := fun j : Over (op i₀) ↦
      etaleSetSheafComparison (c.π.app j.left) (D.map j.hom)
        (c.π.app (op i₀)) (c.w j.hom) G
    ∀ (j : Over (op i₀)) (n : ℕ) (V : Fin n → (D.obj j.left).Etale)
      (a : ∀ q, V q ⟶ Y j) (s : ∀ q, (H j).obj.obj (op (V q))),
      Sieve.ofArrows V a ∈ (D.obj j.left).smallEtaleTopology (Y j) →
      (∀ q, IsAffine (V q).left) →
      (∀ q, (β j).hom.app (op (V q)) (s q) =
        L.obj.map ((B j).map (a q) ≫ (e j).inv).op t) →
    ∃ (j' : Over (op i₀)) (r : j' ⟶ j),
      let b := MorphismProperty.Over.pullback @Etale ⊤ (D.map r.left)
      let hr := (D.map_comp r.left j.hom).symm.trans
        (congrArg (fun z : j'.left ⟶ op i₀ ↦ D.map z) r.w)
      let d := (MorphismProperty.Over.pullbackComp (P := @Etale) (Q := ⊤)
        (D.map r.left) (D.map j.hom) (D.map j'.hom) hr.symm).app W.obj
      let V' := fun q ↦ b.obj (V q)
      let a' := fun q ↦ b.map (a q) ≫ d.inv
      let s' := fun q ↦ (etaleSetSheafComparison (D.map r.left) (D.map j.hom)
        (D.map j'.hom) hr G).hom.app (op (V q)) (s q)
      Sieve.ofArrows V' a' ∈ (D.obj j'.left).smallEtaleTopology (Y j') ∧
      (∀ q, (β j').hom.app (op (V' q)) (s' q) =
        L.obj.map ((B j').map (a' q) ≫ (e j').inv).op t) ∧
      Presieve.Arrows.Compatible (H j').obj a' s'
